reference_review.limitations: One fixed linear Gaussian/partial-correlation realization with analytic CI significance, pc_alpha=alpha and maximum conditioning dimension two. It establishes this graph comparison, not general causal discovery accuracy, error rates, nonlinear/categorical/weighted behavior, latent-variable identification, uncertainty or calibration. The masked case uses a common binary row mask; arbitrary missingness mechanisms are outside scope. The PCMCI+ product canonicalizes contemporaneous links, so endpoint parity is not established.
